name: What is the difference between repairing wood trim and composite trim?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between repairing wood trim and composite trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing wood trim often involves cutting out rotten sections, treating with wood hardener, filling with epoxy or wood filler, and then sanding. Composite trim, being rot-resistant, typically requires different repair methods, such as patching with specialized compounds or replacing damaged sections. The specific material dictates the repair approach; for instance, composite materials often require compatible fillers and adhesives for proper repair and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood trim repair involves removing rot and filling, while composite trim repair uses specialized patching or section replacement due to its different properties.
